name: The Doors

whyMatters.en: LA four-piece without a bass player onstage; The Doors (1967) put organ-led blues-psych and Morrison’s baritone on AM/FM simultaneously.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶四人组，台上无贝斯手；同名首专（1967）把风琴主导的蓝调迷幻与 Morrison 男中音同时送上 AM/FM。

essentialTracks.title: Break On Through (To the Other Side)

note.en: Organ + flamenco-leaning solo; AM edit vs album length.
note.zh: 风琴 + 偏弗拉门戈独奏；AM 剪辑 vs 专辑时长。

scenes.track: Break On Through (To the Other Side)

note.en: Debut opener; jazz-leaning kit under baritone.
note.zh: 首专开场；男中音下偏爵士鼓。

note.en: Fender Rhodes rain FX; late-era cool blues.
note.zh: Fender Rhodes 雨声效果；晚期冷蓝调。

interviewQuotes.text: Expose yourself to your deepest fear; after that, fear has no power.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jim Morrison

lyricQuotes: You know that it would be untrue / You know that I would be a liar

shortBio.en: Morrison–Manzarek organ blues-psych; no bassist onstage; Light My Fire is the hit.
shortBio.zh: Morrison–Manzarek 风琴蓝调迷幻；台上无贝斯；Light My Fire 是热单。

body.en:
Formed 1965. Debut 1967: Manzarek left-hand bass, Krieger bottleneck/flamenco figures, Densmore jazz touch, Morrison baritone. Morrison dies 1971; band limps then stops.

Architecture oddity is the ID: organ as bass + psychedelic blues song forms.
body.zh:
1965 年组建。1967 首专：Manzarek 左手贝斯、Krieger 滑棒/弗拉门戈音型、Densmore 爵士触感、Morrison 男中音。Morrison 1971 去世；乐队短暂延续后停。

架构异数即 ID：风琴当贝斯 + 迷幻蓝调曲式。

title.en: Organ as bass, poetry as front

body.en:
No bassist: Manzarek Fender Rhodes/Vox Continental covers low end. Krieger writes several hits. Morrison sells baritone and spoken breaks.

LA psych that stayed blues-rooted, not San Francisco jam-only.
body.zh:
无贝斯手：Manzarek 的 Fender Rhodes/Vox Continental 补低频。Krieger 写多首热单。Morrison 卖男中音与说白。

仍扎根蓝调的洛杉矶迷幻，不是旧金山纯即兴。

title.zh: 经典四人至 Morrison 去世

body.en:
Only peak silhouette: Morrison / Manzarek / Krieger / Densmore. Post-1971 albums without Morrison are footnote.

Peak flag: 1967–71 studio four.
body.zh:
唯一巅峰剪影：Morrison / Manzarek / Krieger / Densmore。1971 后无 Morrison 专辑是脚注。

巅峰旗：1967–71 录音四人。

title.en: Baritone, organ bass, bottleneck, jazz kit
title.zh: 男中音、风琴贝斯、滑棒、爵士鼓

body.en:
Morrison: leather, notebooks. Manzarek: two-hand split. Krieger: fingerstyle/slide. Densmore: brushes and latin accents.

Four specialists; arrangement leaves space for organ solos.
body.zh:
Morrison：皮衣、笔记本。Manzarek：双手分工。Krieger：指弹/滑音。Densmore：刷片与拉丁点缀。

四名专家；编曲给风琴独奏留空。

title.en: Light My Fire: AM vs album
title.zh: Light My Fire：AM vs 专辑

body.en:
Krieger composition. Extended organ/guitar solos on LP; radio edit cuts middle. Both versions teach the band’s dynamic range.

1967 crossover hit.
body.zh:
Krieger 作曲。LP 上长风琴/吉他独奏；电台剪辑砍中段。两版都教乐队动态范围。

1967 跨界热单。

body.en:
L.A. Woman sessions. Electric piano, rain FX, whispered vocal. Less carnival, more noir blues.

Closing-era citation before Morrison’s death.
body.zh:
L.A. Woman 录音。电钢琴、雨声、低语人声。少马戏团，多黑色电影蓝调。

Morrison 去世前的收官引用。

title.en: Organ-psych cited by later dark rock
title.zh: 后来黑暗摇滚引用的风琴迷幻

body.en:
Post-punk and goth acts borrow Morrison’s baritone drama; keys-as-bass remains a rare architecture lesson.

Short peak, dense radio afterlife.
body.zh:
后朋克与哥特借用 Morrison 男中音戏剧；键盘当贝斯仍是稀有架构课。

巅峰短，电台余生密。

note.zh: Morrison 时期录音与现场峰值。

note.en: Organ-psych hit that put Doors on AM radio.
note.zh: 把 Doors 送上 AM 电台的风琴迷幻热单。
无贝斯风琴架构 + 男中音迷幻蓝调。
